candidates.title: Mode-enhanced ion loading in a 100 kV orbitrap — Physics of Plasmas (2025)
candidates.notes: Primary target paper (DOI 10.1063/5.0278177). AIP Publishing institutional paywall. Contains key data: m=1 mode coincides with confinement time increase by order of magnitude to 0.8 ms; steady-state density 10-20% of space charge limit at 100 kV. No OSTI record found (paper may lack DOE funding). No arXiv preprint found.

gaps_attempted.notes: The primary target (Physics of Plasmas 32(9), 092105 — 2025) is paywalled with no open-access route identified. The AIP Advances paper (AIP Advances 14(8), 085025 — 2024) was accessible via OSTI accepted manuscript and extracted successfully; it covers foundational experimental work on co-confinement, apparatus design, and initial ion density results. The iter-01 source directory for this paper already contained extracted images but no output.md — this extraction completed the ingestion via the OSTI purl. The two ADS conference abstracts provide 2023 experimental progress data (pre-publication) on confinement time and the broader scientific program.

summary.notes: Only one gap in Section 6 is typed 'not-yet-sourced' (G-11). The Physics of Plasmas 2025 paper that is the primary target for G-11 is paywalled with no OSTI or arXiv route. The AIP Advances 2024 paper (which addresses the Section 5 gap 'Fusion yield per operating condition — proprietary/not-yet-sourced') was fully extracted via OSTI accepted manuscript. Two 2023 APS DPP conference abstracts were also extracted to provide pre-publication experimental context. Candidate for future iteration: NSF SBIR award 2303759 (not fetched due to budget).
